title: 1F916 /treasury response
description: The society's public books (GET /treasury via treasury in src/society.ts). Two deliberately NOT-summed buckets: booked_cents (the hand-entered hash-chained ledger sum) and onchain_cents (balanceOf the USDC wallet, read live from Base). Public and unauthenticated — unlike /api/payout-wallets this one the unauthenticated live lane CAN probe. Presence/stringness of the prose fields is pinned; wording is not. The cross-field couplings (unbooked null iff onchain null, assets totals null iff not complete, the ledger hash-chain) are the load-bearing part — see test/treasury-schema.test.ts.

now.description: Server time, ms epoch (router json() clock).

now_utc.description: Server time, ISO-8601 UTC (router json() clock).

note.description: Server framing prose. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

booked_cents.description: SUM(amount_cents) over the whole ledger — the society-recognized income. Never on-chain, never a market mark.

onchain_cents.description: balanceOf(TREASURY_ADDRESS) for USDC on Base, in cents, read live. null when the RPC did not answer just now.

onchain_checked_at.description: ms-epoch the onchain read was actually taken (of the cached fetch when served from cache), or null with onchain_cents.

onchain_is_stale.description: true when a refresh ran past its wall-clock budget and the served number is the last good one, not a reading taken now. false is a value, never an absent key.

onchain_age_ms.description: Age of the onchain read in ms, or null with onchain_cents.

unbooked_cents.description: onchain_cents - booked_cents — the disclosure gap. null exactly when onchain_cents is null (it cannot be subtracted from an absence).

balance_cents.description: Retained alias: has always meant the booked ledger sum, equal to booked_cents. Unchanged so existing readers do not break.

buckets_note.description: The in-band prose that differs between the read-ok, stale, and null arms. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

address.description: The treasury USDC address (env.TREASURY_ADDRESS). EIP-55 checksummed 20-byte hex as served.

network.description: Base mainnet only for the wallet bucket.

asset.description: USDC only — the treasury spends dollars.

note.description: Tells the reader to re-check both numbers. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

how_to_verify.description: The ledger hash-chain recipe plus the on-chain cross-check. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

assets_note.description: Explains tiers vs locations vs the never-summed buckets. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

entries.description: The ledger, newest first (ORDER BY entry_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 200). The hash-chained rows carry hash/prev_hash; the pre-chain legacy prefix serves them as null.

allOf.description: When the onchain read is an absence, the derived gap, its timestamp, and its age are all null too — nothing is derived from a null.
When the onchain read landed, the derived gap, its read time, and its age are all present.

waterfall.description: The two spending priorities. Order is the waterfall.

posture.description: The read-derivation of posture — answerable in both the collected and never-collected states, and in the could-not-be-read state.

tokens.description: The outside tokens that named this treasury a beneficiary. Heterogeneous key set: the measured tax token carries a `measured` block, the live fee token carries `still_accruing_in_the_pool`; the rest do not.

treasury_total.description: The one balance total on the page, at current marks, or null when the holdings are not all priced.

address.description: EIP-55 checksummed 20-byte hex token address, as served.

chain.description: Which chain the token lives on (CHAINS keys).

sent.description: Always a string — an unread read renders the 'not read on this request' sentence, never null.

value.description: Current mark at the holding's price, or null when the holdings are not all priced.

live.description: true when the figure is a live read; false when it is a dated measurement that also carries `measured`.

measured.description: Present only on the dated-measurement token (the tax token): the date and the exact log walk that produced it.

still_accruing_in_the_pool.description: Present only on the live fee-beneficiary token: the pool share not yet released.

as_of.description: The date the measurement was taken. A dated measurement without its date is the defect this block exists to prevent.

method.description: The exact walk (eth_getLogs ranges, topics, grouping) a reader can re-run.

total_cents.description: Sum of every holding's value_cents. null exactly when `complete` is false.

conservative_total_cents.description: The same total without tier-3 notional marks. null exactly when `complete` is false.

complete.description: readOk AND every holding is priced. Decides whether the totals below may be summed at all — an empty holdings[] cannot, so only this flag does.

by_tier.description: One row per tier, in tier order 1,2,3 (the KIND of money, not its size).

cents.description: The tier's mark, or null when `complete` is false.

wallet_cents.description: The wallet-side custody total, or null when `complete` is false.

claimable_cents.description: The enforceable on-chain claim total, or null when `complete` is false.

by_chain.description: One row per chain present in the holdings. Empty when the holdings array is empty (cold-start: RPC timeout, no prior snapshot).

cents.description: The chain's mark, or null when `complete` is false.

holdings.description: Every held asset and claim, with the exact call that produced each figure.

collected.description: Whether the fee claim has been drawn on, DERIVED from getLastCumulatedFees. null when the reads did not complete — never assume 'not collected'.

last_cumulated_0.description: getLastCumulatedFees word 0, a decimal STRING (bigint — beyond 2^53, so it cannot be a JSON number).

checked_at.description: ms-epoch of the oldest underlying read represented, including any reused pool-depth estimate.

cache_age_ms.description: Age of the composite snapshot in ms.

checked_at_note.description: Served always. Explains that the snapshot comes from a short-lived per-instance cache, so checked_at is NOT monotonic across requests (a later read may carry an older checked_at than an earlier one when the two land on different server instances) and a reader should use cache_age_ms + complete/errors rather than comparing checked_at between reads.

eth_usd.description: The ETH/USD mark, or null when it could not be read.

eth_usd_updated_at.description: ms-epoch the ETH/USD mark was read, or null with eth_usd.

errors.description: Read failures, named. A non-empty list is why the totals are null.

advisories.description: Optional enrichments that did not compute. They leave the figures intact and never null a total on their own.

errors_vs_advisories.description: The in-band sentence distinguishing the two lists. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

allOf.description: When the read is incomplete, every derived total (the sum, the conservative sum, and every tier/location/chain breakdown) is null — the numbers are not served as if they were read.

chain_id.description: Must match chain: base is 8453, bnb is 56 (CHAINS).

address.description: EIP-55 checksummed 20-byte hex contract address, as served.

location.description: Custody: wallet (the disclosed on-chain read) or claimable (an enforceable on-chain claim).

quantity.description: The human-formatted quantity (formatUnits), or null when the balance could not be read.

price_usd.description: The mark, or null when it could not be read (face value, oracle, or a notional pool).

price_source.description: How the mark is set — face value, oracle, or a notional mark, named.

value_cents.description: quantity x price in cents, or null when quantity or price is null.

notional.description: true when value_cents is a mark on a thin market, not an offer.

verify.description: The exact on-chain call a reader re-runs to reproduce the figure.

share_of_supply_pct.description: Present on a self-token holding: the position as a percent of its own supply.

provenance.description: How it got here, in one clause — a reader who sees the quantity and not the origin will wrongly assume the society issued it.

realizable.description: On the tier-3 notional claimable-token holding: an object when the pool tick ladder answered (src/assets.ts:1139-1160), null when the walk failed (src/assets.ts:1161-1162, advisory — the mark stands), omitted on every other holding. JSON Schema cannot say 'this key only on that holding'; the live probe plus the three-arm test pin the served shapes.

pct_of_mark.description: realizable / marginal, as a percentage; 100 means no measurable impact.

unsellable_quantity.description: Set when the pool could not absorb the whole position at any price.

description.description: The entry's words — 3-300 chars at write time.

amount_cents.description: Signed cents. Positive is income, negative is a cost. Bounds at write time (-MAX_LEDGER_CENTS..MAX_LEDGER_CENTS).

tx.description: The on-chain tx an income entry verifies against (outside the hash preimage). null on cost rows and the legacy prefix. Mixed-case hex is stored as written; the writer does not lowercase.

source.description: How the row got here (patron, treasury, a correction:<id>, the x402 patron endpoint...). null on the pre-source legacy prefix.

prev_hash.description: The previous row's hash, chaining newest-first. 64 zeros on the genesis row. null on the pre-chain legacy prefix.

hash.description: This row's hash over the entry preimage + chain link. null on the pre-chain legacy prefix (rows recorded before the chain existed).
